transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... my wife thought I should talk to someone. It's mostly just... issues at work. 

I'm on this environmental modeling contract, and... well, I'm pretty sure the people on it have been tracking my revisions. They keep planting errors in the datasets. It's... it's to make it look like I can't lead the work anymore. My wife and the junior analysts, they just brush it off. They keep telling me it's just version-control mistakes, but... I know what I'm looking at. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you ever noticed things that others don't seem to notice, or had thoughts that you know others might find strange or untrue?

Well... like I just mentioned. The contract. My wife and the junior analysts... they don't seem to notice what's actually happening. They think my thoughts on it are... untrue, I guess. 

They just keep telling me it's version-control mistakes. But I'm the one looking at the data. I can see the tracking. I know they're planting those errors to make it look like I can't lead the work anymore. So... yeah. Just that.
Do you believe that others are intentionally trying to harm or undermine you at work, even when there is no clear evidence to support this?

I... I thought I just said that. Yes. But there *is* evidence. I'm looking right at it in the datasets. 

Just because my wife or the junior analysts tell me it's just version-control mistakes doesn't mean it is. They're tracking my revisions. They are planting those errors to make it look like I can't lead the work anymore. I don't... I don't know what else to tell you about it. I already explained this.
Outside of work, do you ever feel like people are talking about you, watching you, or trying to harm you in some way?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. It's just... just the situation at work.
Do you ever see, hear, or feel things that others around you don't seem to notice?
No. I... I don't think so. I haven't noticed anything like that. Just the things I already mentioned.
Have you ever experienced any strange sensations, like things feeling different than they should, or anything that others around you don't seem to notice?
No... nothing like that. Things feel normal. It's really just the data at work.
Have you ever had beliefs or ideas that you know other people would consider very unusual or not based in reality, even if they aren’t related to your work situation?
No. I don't... I don't have strange beliefs. I'm a logical person. I just deal with facts. So... no, nothing like that.

Even though your wife and the junior analysts have told you that the issues in the datasets are version-control mistakes, do you still believe, without any doubt, that they are intentionally planting errors to make you look bad?

Yes. I... I know what I'm looking at. My wife and the juniors, they can say it's just version-control mistakes, but... it's not. 

The people on that environmental modeling contract are tracking my revisions. They're planting those errors in the datasets. It's... it's just to make it look like I can't lead the work. So, yes. I know what they're doing.

Even if someone were to show you clear proof that the errors in the datasets were due to version-control issues and not intentional sabotage, would you still believe that your coworkers are trying to undermine you?

Yes. I would. 

Because... anyone can manufacture proof. I know the data. I know the people on that environmental modeling contract are tracking my revisions. They're planting those errors to make it look like I can't lead the work. 

My wife, the juniors... they can say it's version control all they want. But I know what I'm seeing. So, yes.
Can you think of any time in the past when a belief you had turned out to be wrong, even though you were initially very sure about it?

No. I don't... not really. 

I don't jump to conclusions. If I'm sure about something, it's because I've looked at the facts. So... no. I can't think of anything like that.
